warnings: This is one of TWO alternate foundation-type plans in this set (spread footing here on S-02; pile footing on S-03/หน้า31, per the BOQ index also carrying separate 'แบบฐานรากแผ่' and 'แบบฐานรากเสาเข็ม' price sections). Both are legitimate design options, extracted as separate plan_footing files.

Each footing is printed as '(F<size>),C<n>' — the F-size is the footing's own element_id (the mark also detailed on S-13/S-14); the C<n> suffix names which column TYPE (schedule on S-09) sits on that specific footing, and varies between otherwise-identical footings of the same size. Per §4's point-element merge rule the element_id is the size mark alone (no suffix), so entries are merged by size with a position-parallel 'column_types' array recording which column sits at each grid_refs position — this keeps the required one-entry-per-mark merge while not discarding the printed column-type tag.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'footing_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 5 footing-family elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
